abstract: >
  Regression surface for test-render.R. Every contract type apa_tidy()
  produces, as a table with its note and as an inline string. Not
  documentation, and not shipped to users.
floatsintext: true
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    dev: png
format:
  apaquarto-pdf:
    documentmode: man
  apaquarto-docx: default
  apaquarto-html: default
  apaquarto-typst: default
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(apabayes)
library(apa7)

# Read through system.file(), so this renders against whatever copy of
# apabayes is installed. test-render.R installs the source under test into
# a temporary library and points the render at it, which is the point of
# the whole test: a render that passed against a stale installed copy
# would be worth nothing.
types <- c(
  "parameters", "diagnostics", "hypotheses", "sem_fit", "loo",
  "bf_inclusion", "bf_models", "contrasts", "correlations"
)
obj <- lapply(types, function(ty) {
  readRDS(system.file("extdata", paste0(ty, ".rds"), package = "apabayes"))
})
names(obj) <- types

# Built here, not in the printing chunks: a chunk option is evaluated
# before its own chunk runs, so `apa-note: !expr apa_note(tab)` needs the
# table to already exist.
tab <- lapply(obj, apa_table)
```

# Inline strings

MARKER-INLINE-PARAMETERS `r apa_inline(obj$parameters, "wt")`

MARKER-INLINE-DIAGNOSTICS `r apa_inline(obj$diagnostics)$full_result[1]`

MARKER-INLINE-HYPOTHESES `r apa_inline(obj$hypotheses)$full_result[1]`

MARKER-INLINE-SEM_FIT `r apa_inline(obj$sem_fit)$full_result[1]`

MARKER-INLINE-LOO `r apa_inline(obj$loo)$full_result[1]`

MARKER-INLINE-BF_INCLUSION `r apa_inline(obj$bf_inclusion)$full_result[1]`

MARKER-INLINE-BF_MODELS `r apa_inline(obj$bf_models)$full_result[1]`

MARKER-INLINE-CONTRASTS `r apa_inline(obj$contrasts)$full_result[1]`

MARKER-INLINE-CORRELATIONS `r apa_inline(obj$correlations)$full_result[1]`

```{r}
#| label: tbl-parameters

#| echo: false
#| apa-note: !expr apa_note(tab$parameters)
apa7::apa_flextable(tab$parameters)
```
